title: scrumia-roadmap — ScrumIA
meta_description: scrumia-roadmap: an experimental Claude Code mod — the sprints the agent planned from the lots you asked for, with what is testable at the end of each.
tagline: The sprints the agent planned, and what you will really be able to test.
responsibilities: An experimental Claude Code mod, made of hooks rather than skills. The agent resolves whatever lot the person asked it to take into account — a milestone, ticket numbers, a column — plans it as sprints and records each with its source, objective, tickets and what will be testable at the end. The person reads them in the /roadmap pane.
refusals: It refuses a malformed sprint with its reason, an empty list of testable things unless it is declared as such, and a contradiction between the two. A sprint not recorded under the current session is marked possibly stale rather than passing for fresh.
philosophy: Assumes what matters about a sprint is what a person can try at its end. Costs vigilance: the mod checks the form of that list, not its truth, and the tracker stays the source of truth.
